subject: Joint execution playbook: starter template + weekly close cadence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Park <suzanne.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint execution playbook: starter template + weekly close cadence

Hi Suzanne —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I’ve put together a lightweight "Joint Execution Playbook" (starter template) that captures the evaluation milestones, acceptance criteria, and a proposed weekly close cadence we can run during the pilot. The doc is intentionally short — the goal is a single-page RACI + a 30/60-day milestone view so stakeholders have one place to check progress.

What I shared in the drive:
- Joint Execution Playbook - Template v1.gdoc (link below) — editable; please add any stakeholders or milestones you want included.
- Week0_Assumptions_and_RACI.pptx — a 2-slide summary we can use for your execs.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm the two technical reviewers who need API access during week0?
2) Any blackout dates in the next 30 days (product launches, audits) that would affect our acceptance windows?

I put a tentative weekly sync on Wednesdays 10:00am PT — happy to move. If that cadence works, we’ll capture it in the playbook and use that as our main close ritual.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Hx_example_playbook

Thanks — looking forward to iterating.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Joint execution playbook: starter template + weekly close cadence

Karthik —

Thanks for the doc, and the approach looks good. Quick answers:
• Technical reviewers: myself (suzanne.park@acme-analytics.com) and Aaron Kim (a.kim@acme-analytics.com). Aaron will need API keys and a sandbox account.
• Blackout dates: we have a product release on 2026-10-05 -> that week is tight; outside of that we’re flexible.

A couple of asks from our side before we finalize the playbook:
1) Can you add a short "data residency & logs" acceptance checkbox under security? Our security team will want to know where inference logs are retained and for how long.
2) Can the week0 agenda include a 30-minute infra validation with our SREs?

I’ll give the doc a first pass and add Aaron to the reviewers. If Wednesday 10am PT works, please keep it. Otherwise propose an alternate.

Best,
Suzanne Park
Senior Product Manager | Acme Analytics

Karthik / Marissa —

I took a stab at a compact Week0 outline and dropped it into the doc (see section: "Week0: Assumptions & Runbook"). Summary here so Suzanne has it at a glance:

Week0 proposed:
- Day 0: Kickoff (30m exec + 60m techncial deep-dive) — confirm API keys + sandbox provisioning owner (Acme infra).
- Day 1-2: Infra validation (SRE pairing) — perf smoke tests to validate 99th percentile latency under your sample load.
- Day 3: Integration validation — small workload run, examine KV cache behavior and token accounting.
- Day 4: Acceptance review — checklist: security sign-off (logs/data residency), perf gate, sample output quality check.

Security note: added a checkbox under Acceptance -> Security: "Retention window for inference logs and audit-level export available to customer (Y/N)". Suzanne — can you confirm the expected retention window (e.g., 90 days, 365 days)?

Also suggested that weekly syncs be time boxed to 30 minutes and include: 1) open blockers, 2) tokens/cost update, 3) next-week milestones.

If that looks good I'll formalize the Week0 slides for the exec summary.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Park <suzanne.park@acme-analytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Joint execution playbook: starter template + weekly close cadence

Suzanne / team —

Perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround and clear asks. I made the following updates and next steps: 

Updates applied (see doc):
- Added "Data residency & logs" acceptance checkbox and a short note on default retention (90 days) + optional 365-day archiving.
- Inserted Ben’s Week0 outline into the playbook and created the 2-slide Week0 exec stub (Week0_Assumptions_and_RACI.pptx).
- Set weekly sync: Wednesdays 10:00am PT (30 mins) — calendar invite sent to the attendees.

Next steps:
1) Aaron Kim (ACME) will need sandbox creds — Suzanne, can you loop him in on the provisioning ticket? We will request a scoped API key for the trial.
2) Procurement: once we have a final acceptance matrix, we can attach it to the SOW. Procurement contact on your side (procurement@acme-analytics.com) — we’ll coordinate the commercial milestone dates to match the acceptance gates.
3) I’ll finalize the playbook doc by EOD Friday and share a read-only link for execs; if there are no objections we’ll mark Week0 as ready.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1024
Doc (read-only shared link will be posted here once finalized).

Thanks — very close now.

Best,
